---
title: "Research opportunities"
date-modified: 2026-11-08
---

I welcome inquiries from prospective postdoctoral researchers, research assistants, and students interested in environmental and development economics, climate change, agriculture, and applied econometrics.

Please [contact me](mailto:schonabayashi@soka.ac.jp) with a brief description of your research interests and relevant experience. Opportunities depend on project needs and available funding; I will respond if there is a suitable opportunity.
